  - \makeatother

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r tableaux, results='asis'}
noms = names(params$tableaux)
# L'en-tete natif LaTeX est repete sur toutes les pages, sans fancyhdr.
if (nzchar(params$logo)) {
  cat("\\def\\assembleerlogo{\\includegraphics[height=0.85cm]{\\detokenize{", params$logo, "}}}\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("\\def\\assembleerlogo{}\n")
}
cat("\\pagestyle{assembleer}\n")
for (i in seq_along(noms)) {
  if (i > 1L) cat("\\clearpage\n")
  cat("\\markboth{", knitr:::escape_latex(noms[[i]]), "}{", knitr:::escape_latex(noms[[i]]), "}\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\begingroup\\fontsize{7}{8.5}\\selectfont\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{3pt}\n")
  tab = knitr::kable(params$tableaux[[i]], format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE,
                     longtable = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE)
  tab = sub("{llllll}",
            "{p{1.5cm}p{1.8cm}p{2.3cm}p{2.7cm}p{1.0cm}p{6.3cm}}",
            tab, fixed = TRUE)
  # longtable : groupe et noms des colonnes sur les pages suivantes.
  suite = paste0("\\multicolumn{6}{l}{\\bfseries ",
                 knitr:::escape_latex(noms[[i]]), " — suite} ", "\\\\", "\n")
  if (grepl("\\endfirsthead", tab, fixed = TRUE)) {
    tab = sub("\\endfirsthead", paste0("\\endfirsthead\n", suite), tab, fixed = TRUE)
  } else {
    # Construire un en-tete de continuation a partir de l'en-tete initial.
    debut = regexpr("\\toprule", tab, fixed = TRUE)[1L]
    fin = regexpr("\\midrule", tab, fixed = TRUE)[1L]
    if (debut > 0L && fin > debut) {
      colonnes = substr(tab, debut, fin + nchar("\\midrule") - 1L)
      tab = sub("\\midrule", paste0("\\midrule\n\\endfirsthead\n",
                suite, colonnes, "\n\\endhead"), tab, fixed = TRUE)
    }
  }
  cat(tab, "\n\\endgroup\n")
}
```
